'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Bryan Batdorf LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bryan Batdorf]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Why So Serious?

* '''Player:''' [[Bryan Batdorf]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
